units.outcomes: Six welfare-support items on their supplied 0-1 scales.
units.exposures: migstock_wb, migstock_un, and migstock_oecd; percent foreign-born.
units.analysis_unit: Country after equal-weight averaging of available country-year means.

preprocessing.complete_case: For each model require country ID, year, outcome, focal exposure, and named controls. The all_three_observed rule additionally requires all three stock measures.
preprocessing.country_year: Arithmetic means over complete respondent rows within iso_country and year.
preprocessing.country: Equal-weight arithmetic means over available country-years within iso_country.
preprocessing.fit_weighting: One equally weighted row per realized country.

inference.primary: HC3 covariance with two-sided Student t reference and df=n_countries-design_rank.
inference.working_assumptions: Independent country-history sampling units, linear conditional mean in named observed regressors, and approximate HC3 t calibration.

structural_events: rank deficient full design under np.linalg.matrix_rank default tolerance
nonpositive or nonfinite focal exposure variance
HC3 unit leverage: max hat diagonal >= 1 - 1e-12
nonpositive or nonfinite focal HC3 variance, including a zero t-statistic denominator
unavailable_policy.structural_test_rule: Preserve raw slope, SE, and p as unavailable; separately set test_inference_p=1 with the enumerated reason code.
unavailable_policy.unexpected_rule: Software, runtime, schema, and other unexpected errors remain unavailable with test_inference_p=null; no fallback.

m_reference.eligible_pool: Configurations with raw_status=available and finite Z=slope/HC3SE.
m_reference.statistic: Slope divided by HC3 standard error; doubled smaller inclusive empirical tail, capped at one.
m_reference.unavailable_rule: Retain all 108 rows and failure classifications. If the selected statistic or eligible pool is undefined, catalogue m is unavailable.

models.population: Countries represented by the supplied respondent data that satisfy this model's prespecified complete-case and coverage rules; realized country IDs and count are sample facts reported after fitting.
models.sample_restrictions: Model-specific complete cases; coverage=all_three_observed; controls=['log_gdp', 'ginid_solt']; no result-dependent exclusions.
